identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Lenvatinib (MK-7902/E7080) in Combination With Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Versus Standard of Care in Participants With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (MK-7902-017/E7080-G000-325/LEAP-017)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3 Randomized Study of Lenvatinib in Combination With Pembrolizumab Versus Standard of Care in Participants With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Who Have Received and Progressed On or After or Became Intolerant to Prior Treatment

armGroups.label: lenvatinib+pembrolizumab
armGroups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab 400 mg via intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 of each 6-week (Q6W) Cycle for up to 18 cycles (up to approximately 2 years) PLUS lenvatinib 20 mg via oral capsule once daily until progressive disease.

armGroups.label: standard of care treatment (regorafenib OR TAS-102)
armGroups.description: Participants receive regorafenib 160 mg via oral tablet once daily on Days 1 through 21 of each 4-week cycle OR TAS-102 (trifluridine and tipiracil hydrochloride) 35 mg/m\^2 via oral tablet twice a day on Days 1 through 5 and Days 8-12 of each 4-week cycle until progressive disease.
